# Diagnosis: `test-external-script-render-drift`

**Verdict: false regression — the external fleet script (`~/.hermes/scripts/bunker-qa.sh`) was redeployed after the last green baseline, and its new render no longer emits the token the test asserts. The project diff is innocent. Do NOT edit the cross-project script. Route ownership to the fleet board and quarantine the drift in `known-fails.txt`.**

Case: `tests/federation/qa-harness-cell-detection.test.js` (renders `~/.hermes/scripts/bunker-qa.sh` via `__gen-remote`; assertion `'act -q --pull'` at test line 930) reports 1 new pass→fail in the full-suite `verify-no-regression` gate.

## 1. Root-cause analysis

The test is a **contract test against an out-of-repo artifact**. Its expected output is a function of `bunker-qa.sh`'s current contents, not of anything in this repository. The runner is merely the messenger.

| # | Step | Observation | Conclusion |
|---|------|-------------|------------|
| 1 | Rerun the file in isolation | 29 passed / 5 failed, identical set | Not test load, ordering, or shared state |
| 2 | Grep test source for out-of-repo paths | Header names `~/.hermes/scripts/bunker-qa.sh` and honors `BUNKER_QA_SCRIPT` override | Failure depends on an external file |
| 3 | `stat` mtime + `git log` on script repo | mtime **2026-10-30 14:34:48**; commits `3ef12902` (low-disk refusal), `9628674c0c` (flock), `a7de945a2b` (battery-lock keeper) all land **after** the last green baseline | External deploy postdates baseline |
| 4 | Run external subcommand by hand, diff tokens | Render = **129864 bytes, RC=0**, but `grep -c 'act -q --pull'` = **0** | New render is valid but semantically changed; asserted token gone |
| 5 | Attribute + route | External change is the cause → file board row, do not patch externally-owned file | See §2b |

Corroboration:
- **Sibling failing cells** of the same file are **already in `known-fails.txt`** — this file/external-contract is a recognized drift surface, so a new cell failing is expected behavior, not a new repo defect.
- **Causality bound (own diff scope):** the only changes in this repo are `.env.example` (comment-only) and new `docs/*.md` markdown. Neither can alter the byte stream produced by a shell script.

Timeline proof:

```
external script mtime : 2026-10-30 14:34:48
fleet commits         : 3ef12902, 9628674c0c, a7de945a2b   (all > last green baseline)
project diff          : .env.example (comments) + docs/*.md only
```

## 2. Exact fix

**Do not modify `~/.hermes/scripts/bunker-qa.sh` from this project's foreman.** It is fleet-owned; a cross-project edit violates ownership/route policy and hides the drift from the team that owns it.

### 2a. Quarantine the drift (unblock the gate, no false red)

```bash
# from PROJECT_ROOT
cp known-fails.txt known-fails.txt.bak
cat >> known-fails.txt <<'EOF'
# --- test-external-script-render-drift (INT-<project>-003) ---
# External artifact ~/.hermes/scripts/bunker-qa.sh redeployed 2026-10-30 14:34:48
# (fleet 3ef12902 / 9628674c0c / a7de945a2b) stopped emitting 'act -q --pull'.
# Own diff scope: comment-only .env.example + docs/*.md. Quarantined pending fleet fix.
tests/federation/qa-harness-cell-detection.test.js :: <failing cell 1>
tests/federation/qa-harness-cell-detection.test.js :: <failing cell 2>
tests/federation/qa-harness-cell-detection.test.js :: <failing cell 3>
tests/federation/qa-harness-cell-detection.test.js :: <failing cell 4>
tests/federation/qa-harness-cell-detection.test.js :: <failing cell 5>
EOF
```

Replace `<failing cell N>` with the exact test names from the isolation run. A file-level entry is acceptable only if it does not mask unrelated cells.

### 2b. File the board row and route ownership (tick-414 doctrine, `INT-<project>-003`)

```
ID:      INT-<project>-003
Title:   [fleet] bunker-qa.sh render no longer emits 'act -q --pull';
         drops tests/federation/qa-harness-cell-detection.test.js cells
Owner:   fleet / bunker-qa + hermes-scripts maintainers   (NOT this project)
Blocked: this project's verify-no-regression gate (1 new pass->fail; 5 cells)

Repro one-liner:
  BUNKER_QA_SCRIPT=~/.hermes/scripts/bunker-qa.sh \
    <render helper used by __gen-remote> > /tmp/render.out; \
    echo "bytes=$(wc -c </tmp/render.out) rc=$?"; \
    grep -c 'act -q --pull' /tmp/render.out
  # observed: bytes=129864 rc=0 token_count=0

Timeline proof:
  stat -c '%y' ~/.hermes/scripts/bunker-qa.sh   # 2026-10-30 14:34:48
  git -C ~/.hermes log --format='%h %ci %s' -5 -- scripts/bunker-qa.sh
  # 3ef12902 low-disk refusal
  # 9628674c0c flock
  # a7de945a2b battery-lock keeper
  (all postdate last green baseline <BASELINE_TS>)

Acceptance (fleet):
  A1. `grep -c 'act -q --pull'` on the post-change render returns >= 1, OR
  A2. If token removal was intentional, publish the new render contract,
      update the test to the agreed token, and re-record the baseline.
  Evidence: 129864-byte render (or hash) + token count before/after.
```

### 2c. Repo-side hardening (follow-up, this repo owns it)

1. Have `__gen-remote` record SHA-256 of the render (and/or `bunker-qa.sh`) in the failure message.
2. Pin the external contract: assert on a vendored golden fixture, or gate the strict token assertion behind an unpinned `BUNKER_QA_SCRIPT`, so CI renders a deterministic fixture.
3. Link the `known-fails.txt` entry to `INT-<project>-003`; remove it when fleet lands A1/A2.

## 3. Verification

### 3a. Confirm the failure is external

```bash
export PROJECT_ROOT=/path/to/repo
export SCRIPT=~/.hermes/scripts/bunker-qa.sh

cd "$PROJECT_ROOT"
<project test runner> tests/federation/qa-harness-cell-detection.test.js --runInBand   # 29 passed / 5 failed

grep -n 'BUNKER_QA_SCRIPT\|__gen-remote\|bunker-qa.sh' tests/federation/qa-harness-cell-detection.test.js

stat -c '%y %n' "$SCRIPT"
git -C "$(dirname "$SCRIPT")" log --format='%h %ci %s' -5 -- "$(basename "$SCRIPT")"

"$SCRIPT" <subcommand> > /tmp/render.out 2>/tmp/render.err
echo "rc=$? bytes=$(wc -c </tmp/render.out)"
grep -c 'act -q --pull' /tmp/render.out    # => 0  (the red)
```

### 3b. Confirm the gate is clean after quarantine

```bash
<verify-no-regression gate>
# Expected: 0 new pass->fail; the 5 cells are now accounted for in known-fails.txt.
```

### 3c. Confirm causality bound (own diff)

```bash
git diff --name-only <BASELINE>..HEAD
git diff <BASELINE>..HEAD -- .env.example    # expect comment-only hunks
# docs/*.md additive; no executable path touches the render pipeline
```

### 3d. Close-out criteria

- [ ] Full-suite gate: **0 new pass→fail** after quarantine.
- [ ] `INT-<project>-003` open with owner = fleet and the repro one-liner.
- [ ] Fleet attaches before/after render evidence (bytes + token count).
- [ ] On A1/A2: remove quarantined entries, re-record baseline, re-run gate to green.

## 4. Why this is the correct action

- **Attribution:** external deploy (mtime + commits) postdates the last green baseline; render is RC=0 but token count 0 → the external artifact changed under the test.
- **Blast radius:** only external-contract cells fail; siblings already known-fails.
- **Causality bound:** own diff is `.env.example` comments + new markdown — incapable of changing a shell render.
- **Ownership:** fleet owns `bunker-qa.sh`; editing it from this project is a cross-project violation that masks real drift. Correct action is a routed board row + quarantine (tick-414 / `INT-<project>-003`).

---

**Note on environment:** this sandbox contains only `/workspace/problem.json` (the case description) and no repository or `~/.hermes` tree, so the commands above are written against the case's recorded evidence and are ready to run in the real workspace. No repo test or external script was modified.
